name: com.nathanaeldousa.ai-api-tracker
description: Monitor AI API usage and balances directly from your Stream Deck

scripts.build: rollup -c && npm run assets && npm run deploy
scripts.deploy: pkill -f 'plugin.cjs.*ai-api-tracker' 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; streamdeck restart com.nathanaeldousa.ai-api-tracker && echo 'Deployed to Stream Deck'

author: Nathanael Dousa
